## About
San Antonio Muscle & Spine Clinic is a chiropractic office in San Antonio, and we call ourselves the city's Y-Strap chiropractor. Dr. Peña works on the muscles as well as the spine, so a visit can include hands-on deep tissue work alongside your adjustment.
Patients tell us they come away understanding their own bodies a little better. One reviewer wrote that Dr. Peña spent time explaining the skeletal and muscular anatomy behind their pain. Another said he gave easy instructions to keep recovery going at home.
We're grateful for a 5-star rating from 97 Google reviews, and for the veterans who have trusted us with their care.

## Services
- Y-Strap: Y-Strap work is what we're known for. Our website calls us San Antonio's Y-Strap chiropractor.
- Deep tissue work with chiropractic care: One reviewer noted that Dr. Peña combines deep tissue muscle work with chiropractic adjustments in the same visit.
- Dry needling: Used when it fits the problem. One reviewer came in with ongoing shoulder pain and said they left pain free after dry needling.

## FAQ
Q: Where is the clinic?
A: We're in San Antonio, TX 78230.

Q: Which days are you open?
A: We see patients Tuesday through Friday. The clinic is closed Saturday, Sunday and Monday.
